definitions.explanation: A large gathering of people, often in a public space. Can be neutral or carry negative connotations of an uncontrolled or anonymous mass.

examples.japanese: {群衆|ぐんしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広場|ひろば}→広場：00104_hiroba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: A crowd gathered in the plaza.

examples.japanese: {群衆|ぐんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{迷子|まいご}→迷子：03729_maigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧そうだった。
examples.english: I almost got lost in the crowd.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{興奮|こうふん}した→興奮する：25351_koufunsuru⟧{群衆|ぐんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦労|くろう}した→苦労する：25357_kurousuru⟧。
examples.english: The police struggled to control the agitated crowd.

notes:
A somewhat formal or literary word for a large gathering of people. In everyday speech, ⟦{人込|ひとご}み→人込み：03709_hitogomi⟧ or ⟦{人|ひと}だかり→人だかり：22286_hitodakari⟧ are more common for neutral crowds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {群衆|ぐんしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧ (a crowd gathers)
- {群衆|ぐんしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{紛|まぎ}れる→紛れる：07572_magireru⟧ (to blend into the crowd)
- {群衆|ぐんしゅう}⟦{心理|しんり}→心理：03332_shinri⟧ (mob mentality)

USAGE:
{群衆|ぐんしゅう} often appears in news reports and literary contexts. It can imply an anonymous, faceless mass and is commonly used when describing demonstrations, riots, or large public events.
